title: Bismillah alamdar
body:
subhe ashoor puakre ye shahe karbobala
kahan ho baazu e shabbir sakina ke chacha
aaya shabbir ki awaaz pe wo rab e wafa
sheh pukare ay mere bhai ay baba ki dua
fatema zehra ki ummeed bano
afsar e lashkar e tauheed bano
abbas abbas abbas bismillah
bismillah alamdar bismillah alamdar
<<DIVIDER>>
afsar e fauj e khuda
bismillah alamdar bismillah alamdar
aks e shaahe la fataa
bismillah alamdar bismillah alamdar
alamdar alamdar alamdar
alamdar alamdar alamdar
<<DIVIDER>>
afsar kabhi aisa kisi lashkar ne na paaya
rutba kabhi aisa kisi safdar ne na paaya
misle hyder koi jarraar kahan milta hai
aap ke jaisa alamdar kahan milta hai
mere baba ke zabardast pisar
ay mere bhai mere zor e kamar
<<DIVIDER>>

<<DIVIDER>>
sheh bole ye farman e khuda wande jali hai
farzand e nabi mai hoo tu farzand e ali hai
tu agar noor e jali hai to jali ban ke dikha
baith ash'al pe zamane ko ali ban ke dikha
maut ko aagayi ye sun ke qaza
choom kar ghazi ko sarwar ne kaha
<<DIVIDER>>

<<DIVIDER>>
sultano ke sultan ne waliyon ke wali ne
maanga hai tumhe apne duaon mein ali ne
parchame azmate tauheed ke haqdaar ho tum
mai hoo meyaar e khuda aur mera meyaar ho tum
badr mein arsh se utra jo alam
saumpte hai wo tumhe aaj se hum
<<DIVIDER>>

alamdar alamdar alamdar
<<DIVIDER>>
dam kis mein hai nazron se teri nazrein milaye
haibat teri toofanon ko khaatir mein na laaye
tu agar chaahe to baazi ko palat sakta hai
jumbish e abru se kaunain ulat sakta hai
aao baba ki zira bhi pehno
dosh par unki abaa bhi pehno
<<DIVIDER>>

<<DIVIDER>>
seh paaunga kaise mai bhala teri judaai
kis dil se kardun tujhe ruqsat mere bhai
jao ab binte payambar se basharat lelo
jisne paala hai tujhe us s e ijazat lelo
maa ne haathon se jo kurta tha siya
kehna shabbir ne wo maang liya
<<DIVIDER>>

<<DIVIDER>>
sun kar ye bayan zainab e muztar ne sada di
pardes mein ye kaisi khabar haye suna di
kyun kar dil e umeed jahan tod rahe ho
sunti hoo ke ab tum bhi hamein chod rahe ho
aur phir bibi ne ro kar akhtar
ek taweez yun baandha keh kar
<<DIVIDER>>
